title: Find out whether the 17 November crash while scrubbing a long edit can happen in the shipped app
goal: The loop's test copy of the app crashed once on 17 November while a runner was scrubbing the long reference edit. The Mac stopped the app inside a window layout pass, not in a Photonz step, and the same walk ran 14 more times without crashing. Find out whether a person scrubbing a long edit could hit it, and fix it if they could.

Digest spot check 2026-11-17: the report's top frames are AppKit's, +[NSApplication _crashOnException:] under -[NSView updateConstraintsForSubtreeIfNeeded] in the display cycle; photonz_nextEvent is only the event pump it was called from. The long-edit pass 13 runner saw this crash once in 6 runs of scrub-never-blacks-out-walk with its change in, and 0 in 9 more runs (its log, 2026-11-17T11:04Z): it names -[NSWindow _postWindowNeedsUpdateConstraints] from NSHostingView.updateWindowContentSizeExtremaIfNecessary. That change has since landed (f87714cbc), so this cannot be put down to unfinished source. Command to try: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/scrub-never-blacks-out-walk.json, repeated.
acceptance: The scrub walk on the long edit (Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/scrub-never-blacks-out-walk.json) is run at least 20 times on a probe built from main, and crash-watch is read after: the count of crashes is written in the log
If it crashes again: the AppKit exception message is captured (it is missing from the 17 November report), the cause is fixed in Photonz code, and a test or walk fails before and passes after
If it does not: closed with the run count as evidence, and crash-watch marks the report as seen once and not reproduced

log.note: Digest spot check 2026-11-17: no reproduction command in the notes, only the crash report, so it does not hold the top of p1. I read the report: an AppKit exception in a window constraint update pass, caught by _crashOnException, with the Photonz event pump below it. The pass 13 runner had already met it once in 15 runs of scrub-never-blacks-out-walk and could not repeat it. Moved p1 to p2, retitled as the open question, re-tagged unmanned-loop to video-perf (a crash while scrubbing is a playback fault), and wrote the command to try into its notes and checklist. I did not run the walk 20 times here: that is the task.
